claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN trains the very deep VGG16 network 9 times faster than R-CNN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Fast R-CNN trains the very deep VGG16 network 9× faster than R-CNN

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN is 213 times faster at test-time than R-CNN.
Fast R-CNN achieves a higher mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012 compared to R-CNN.
claims.evidence_quote_short: achieves a higher mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN uses a single-stage training algorithm that jointly learns to classify object proposals and refine their spatial locations.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We propose a single-stage training algorithm that jointly learns to classify object proposals and refine their spatial locations.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fast R-CNN does not require disk storage for feature caching.
claims.evidence_quote_short: No disk storage is required for feature caching

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fine-tuning the convolutional layers in VGG16 improves mAP from 61.4% to 66.9%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This ablation emulates single-scale SPPnet training and decreases mAP from 66.9% to 61.4%

claims.claim_text_normalized: Multi-task training improves pure classification accuracy relative to training for classification alone.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Across all three networks we observe that multi-task training improves pure classification accuracy relative to training for classification alone.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Increasing the number of object proposals beyond a certain point slightly hurts mAP.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We find that mAP rises and then falls slightly as the proposal count increases
